21	  match e__6 with

132	     reduct e1 e1' ->

135	     lc_trm A ->

138	
139	Inductive sub : env -> trm -> trm -> trm -> Prop :=

141	     wf G ->
142	     sub G trm_star trm_star trm_star
143	 | sub_var_refl : forall (G:env) (x5:var) (A e:trm),
144	     wf G ->
145	      binds ( x5 ) ( (bind_sub e A) ) ( G )  ->
146	     sub G (trm_var_f x5) (trm_var_f x5) A
147	 | sub_var_trans : forall (G:env) (x5:var) (e2 A e1:trm),
148	      binds ( x5 ) ( (bind_sub e1 A) ) ( G )  ->
149	     sub G e1 e2 A ->
150	     sub G (trm_var_f x5) e2 A

152	      sub ( G ) ( e ) ( e ) ( A )  ->

155	      sub ( G ) ( A ) ( A ) ( trm_star )  ->
156	     sub G trm_top trm_top A
157	 | sub_abs : forall (L:vars) (G:env) (e1 A e2 e2' B:trm),
158	      sub ( G ) ( e1 ) ( e1 ) ( A )  ->
159	      sub ( G ) ( A ) ( A ) ( trm_star )  ->

169	     sub G e' e A ->
170	      sub ( G ) ( A ) ( A ) ( trm_star )  ->

173	       sub ( G ) ( e ) ( e ) ( A )   ->
174	      sub ( G ) ( e' ) ( e' ) ( A' )  ->

192	     wf  empty

file.content:
From TLC Require Import LibLN.

Inductive trm : Set :=
 | trm_var_b (_:nat)
 | trm_var_f (x5:var)
 | trm_star : trm
 | trm_top : trm
 | trm_app (e1:trm) (e2:trm)
 | trm_abs (e1:trm) (A:trm) (e2:trm)
 | trm_prod (e:trm) (A:trm) (B:trm)
 | trm_castup (A:trm) (e:trm)
 | trm_castdn (e:trm)
 | trm_anno (e:trm) (A:trm)  .

Inductive binding : Set :=
 | bind_sub (e:trm) (A:trm)  .

Definition env := LibEnv.env binding.

Fixpoint open_trm_wrt_trm_rec (k:nat) (e_5:trm) (e__6:trm) {struct e__6}: trm :=
  match e__6 with
  | (trm_var_b nat) => If (k = nat) then e_5 else (trm_var_b nat)
  | (trm_var_f x5) => trm_var_f x5
  | trm_star => trm_star
  | trm_top => trm_top
  | (trm_app e1 e2) => trm_app (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k e_5 e1) (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k e_5 e2)
  | (trm_abs e1 A e2) => trm_abs (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k e_5 e1) (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k e_5 A) (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec (S k) e_5 e2)
  | (trm_prod e A B) => trm_prod (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k e_5 e) (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k e_5 A) (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec (S k) e_5 B)
  | (trm_castup A e) => trm_castup (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k e_5 A) (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k e_5 e)
  | (trm_castdn e) => trm_castdn (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k e_5 e)
  | (trm_anno e A) => trm_anno (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k e_5 e) (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k e_5 A)
end.

Definition open_binding_wrt_trm_rec (k:nat) (e5:trm) (b5:binding) : binding :=
  match b5 with
  | (bind_sub e A) => bind_sub (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k e5 e) (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k e5 A)
end.

Definition open_binding_wrt_trm e5 b5 := open_binding_wrt_trm_rec 0 b5 e5.

Definition open_trm_wrt_trm e_5 e__6 := open_trm_wrt_trm_rec 0 e__6 e_5.

Inductive lc_trm : trm -> Prop :=
 | lc_trm_var_f : forall (x5:var),
     (lc_trm (trm_var_f x5))
 | lc_trm_star :
     (lc_trm trm_star)
 | lc_trm_top :
     (lc_trm trm_top)
 | lc_trm_app : forall (e1 e2:trm),
     (lc_trm e1) ->
     (lc_trm e2) ->
     (lc_trm (trm_app e1 e2))
 | lc_trm_abs : forall (L:vars) (e1 A e2:trm),
     (lc_trm e1) ->
     (lc_trm A) ->
      ( forall x5 , x5 \notin  L  -> lc_trm  ( open_trm_wrt_trm e2 (trm_var_f x5) )  )  ->
     (lc_trm (trm_abs e1 A e2))
 | lc_trm_prod : forall (L:vars) (e A B:trm),
     (lc_trm e) ->
     (lc_trm A) ->
      ( forall x5 , x5 \notin  L  -> lc_trm  ( open_trm_wrt_trm B (trm_var_f x5) )  )  ->
     (lc_trm (trm_prod e A B))
 | lc_trm_castup : forall (A e:trm),
     (lc_trm A) ->
     (lc_trm e) ->
     (lc_trm (trm_castup A e))
 | lc_trm_castdn : forall (e:trm),
     (lc_trm e) ->
     (lc_trm (trm_castdn e))
 | lc_trm_anno : forall (e A:trm),
     (lc_trm e) ->
     (lc_trm A) ->
     (lc_trm (trm_anno e A)).

Inductive lc_binding : binding -> Prop :=
 | lc_bind_sub : forall (e A:trm),
     (lc_trm e) ->
     (lc_trm A) ->
     (lc_binding (bind_sub e A)).

Fixpoint fv_trm (e_5:trm) : vars :=
  match e_5 with
  | (trm_var_b nat) => \{}
  | (trm_var_f x5) => \{x5}
  | trm_star => \{}
  | trm_top => \{}
  | (trm_app e1 e2) => (fv_trm e1) \u (fv_trm e2)
  | (trm_abs e1 A e2) => (fv_trm e1) \u (fv_trm A) \u (fv_trm e2)
  | (trm_prod e A B) => (fv_trm e) \u (fv_trm A) \u (fv_trm B)
  | (trm_castup A e) => (fv_trm A) \u (fv_trm e)
  | (trm_castdn e) => (fv_trm e)
  | (trm_anno e A) => (fv_trm e) \u (fv_trm A)
end.

Definition fv_binding (b5:binding) : vars :=
  match b5 with
  | (bind_sub e A) => (fv_trm e) \u (fv_trm A)
end.

Fixpoint subst_trm (e_5:trm) (y5:var) (e__6:trm) {struct e__6} : trm :=
  match e__6 with
  | (trm_var_b nat) => trm_var_b nat
  | (trm_var_f x5) => (If x5 = y5 then e_5 else (trm_var_f x5))
  | trm_star => trm_star
  | trm_top => trm_top
  | (trm_app e1 e2) => trm_app (subst_trm e_5 y5 e1) (subst_trm e_5 y5 e2)
  | (trm_abs e1 A e2) => trm_abs (subst_trm e_5 y5 e1) (subst_trm e_5 y5 A) (subst_trm e_5 y5 e2)
  | (trm_prod e A B) => trm_prod (subst_trm e_5 y5 e) (subst_trm e_5 y5 A) (subst_trm e_5 y5 B)
  | (trm_castup A e) => trm_castup (subst_trm e_5 y5 A) (subst_trm e_5 y5 e)
  | (trm_castdn e) => trm_castdn (subst_trm e_5 y5 e)
  | (trm_anno e A) => trm_anno (subst_trm e_5 y5 e) (subst_trm e_5 y5 A)
end.

Definition subst_binding (e5:trm) (y5:var) (b5:binding) : binding :=
  match b5 with
  | (bind_sub e A) => bind_sub (subst_trm e5 y5 e) (subst_trm e5 y5 A)
end.

Inductive reduct : trm -> trm -> Prop :=
 | reduct_beta : forall (e3 A e1 e2:trm),
     lc_trm e3 ->
     lc_trm A ->
     lc_trm (trm_abs e3 A e1) ->
     lc_trm e2 ->
     reduct (trm_app  ( (trm_abs e3 A e1) )  e2)  (open_trm_wrt_trm  e1   e2 )
 | reduct_app : forall (e1 e2 e1':trm),
     lc_trm e2 ->
     reduct e1 e1' ->
     reduct (trm_app e1 e2) (trm_app e1' e2)
 | reduct_castdn : forall (e1 e1':trm),
     reduct e1 e1' ->
     reduct (trm_castdn e1) (trm_castdn e1')
 | reduct_castelim : forall (A e:trm),
     lc_trm A ->
     lc_trm e ->
     reduct (trm_castdn  ( (trm_castup A e) ) ) e.

Inductive sub : env -> trm -> trm -> trm -> Prop :=
 | sub_ax : forall (G:env),
     wf G ->
     sub G trm_star trm_star trm_star
 | sub_var_refl : forall (G:env) (x5:var) (A e:trm),
     wf G ->
      binds ( x5 ) ( (bind_sub e A) ) ( G )  ->
     sub G (trm_var_f x5) (trm_var_f x5) A
 | sub_var_trans : forall (G:env) (x5:var) (e2 A e1:trm),
      binds ( x5 ) ( (bind_sub e1 A) ) ( G )  ->
     sub G e1 e2 A ->
     sub G (trm_var_f x5) e2 A
 | sub_top : forall (G:env) (e A:trm),
      sub ( G ) ( e ) ( e ) ( A )  ->
     sub G e trm_top A
 | sub_top_refl : forall (G:env) (A:trm),
      sub ( G ) ( A ) ( A ) ( trm_star )  ->
     sub G trm_top trm_top A
 | sub_abs : forall (L:vars) (G:env) (e1 A e2 e2' B:trm),
      sub ( G ) ( e1 ) ( e1 ) ( A )  ->
      sub ( G ) ( A ) ( A ) ( trm_star )  ->
      ( forall x5 , x5 \notin  L  ->  sub  ( G  &  x5 ~ (bind_sub e1 A) )   ( open_trm_wrt_trm e2 (trm_var_f x5) )   ( open_trm_wrt_trm e2' (trm_var_f x5) )   ( open_trm_wrt_trm B (trm_var_f x5) )   )  ->
      ( forall x5 , x5 \notin  L  ->  sub (  ( G  &  x5 ~ (bind_sub e1 A) )  ) (  ( open_trm_wrt_trm B (trm_var_f x5) )  ) (  ( open_trm_wrt_trm B (trm_var_f x5) )  ) ( trm_star )  )  ->
     sub G  ( (trm_abs e1 A e2) )   ( (trm_abs e1 A e2') )  (trm_prod e1 A B)
 | sub_app : forall (G:env) (e1 A e2 C e3 B:trm),
     sub G e1 e2 (trm_prod e3 B C) ->
     sub G A e3 B ->
     sub G (trm_app e1 A) (trm_app e2 A)  (open_trm_wrt_trm  C   A )
 | sub_prod : forall (L:vars) (G:env) (e A B e' A' B':trm),
     sub G A' A trm_star ->
     sub G e' e A ->
      sub ( G ) ( A ) ( A ) ( trm_star )  ->
      ( forall x5 , x5 \notin  L  ->   sub (  ( G  &  x5 ~ (bind_sub e A) )  ) (  ( open_trm_wrt_trm B (trm_var_f x5) )  ) (  ( open_trm_wrt_trm B (trm_var_f x5) )  ) ( trm_star )   )  ->
      ( forall x5 , x5 \notin  L  -> sub  ( G  &  x5 ~ (bind_sub e' A') )   ( open_trm_wrt_trm B (trm_var_f x5) )   ( open_trm_wrt_trm B' (trm_var_f x5) )  trm_star )  ->
       sub ( G ) ( e ) ( e ) ( A )   ->
      sub ( G ) ( e' ) ( e' ) ( A' )  ->
     sub G  ( (trm_prod e A B) )   ( (trm_prod e' A' B') )  trm_star
 | sub_castup : forall (G:env) (B e1 e2 A:trm),
      sub ( G ) ( B ) ( B ) ( trm_star )  ->
     sub G e1 e2 A ->
     reduct B A ->
     sub G (trm_castup B e1) (trm_castup B e2) B
 | sub_castdn : forall (G:env) (e1 e2 B A:trm),
      sub ( G ) ( B ) ( B ) ( trm_star )  ->
     sub G e1 e2 A ->
     reduct A B ->
     sub G (trm_castdn e1) (trm_castdn e2) B
 | sub_sub : forall (G:env) (e1 e2 B A:trm),
     sub G e1 e2 A ->
     sub G A B trm_star ->
     sub G e1 e2 B
with wf : env -> Prop :=
 | wf_nil :
     wf  empty
 | wf_cons : forall (G:env) (x5:var) (e A:trm),
      sub ( G ) ( e ) ( e ) ( A )  ->
      sub ( G ) ( A ) ( A ) ( trm_star )  ->
      ( x5  # ( G ))  ->
     wf  ( G  &  x5 ~ (bind_sub e A) ) .

Inductive ivalue : trm -> Prop :=
 | ivalue_top :
     ivalue trm_top
 | ivalue_var : forall (x5:var),
     ivalue (trm_var_f x5)
 | ivalue_app : forall (e1 e2:trm),
     lc_trm e2 ->
     ivalue e1 ->
     ivalue (trm_app e1 e2)
 | ivalue_castdn : forall (e:trm),
     ivalue e ->
     ivalue (trm_castdn e).

Inductive value : trm -> Prop :=
 | value_star :
     value trm_star
 | value_ivalue : forall (e:trm),
     ivalue e ->
     value e
 | value_abs : forall (e1 A e2:trm),
     lc_trm e1 ->
     lc_trm A ->
     lc_trm (trm_abs e1 A e2) ->
     value (trm_abs e1 A e2)
 | value_prod : forall (e A B:trm),
     lc_trm e ->
     lc_trm A ->
     lc_trm (trm_prod e A B) ->
     value (trm_prod e A B)
 | value_castup : forall (A e:trm),
     lc_trm A ->
     lc_trm e ->
     value (trm_castup A e).

# 167 — Unified typing and subtyping: type safety

## Task

Show that weak-head reduction preserves the unified typing judgment and that a closed well-typed term is a value or can take a weak-head step.

Prove all of the following declarations in `Task.v`:

- `subject_reduction_wh`
- `progress_empty_wh`

- `input/Task.v` is the target file; in the proof workspace, it is `Task.v`.
- Any other supplied `.v` files provide support definitions. Use `_CoqProject` for the source list and library mappings.

The project already includes the listed dependencies; do not install anything for the proof run.

- Edit only `Task.v` in the submitted solution. You may add helper definitions and lemmas there. Keep all supplied definitions and target names, statements, and hypotheses unchanged. Do not change support files or `_CoqProject`.
- Do not use `Admitted`, `admit`, or `Abort` in the submitted solution. Do not add axioms or new global assumptions (including via `Axiom`, `Parameter`, or `Conjecture`), disable kernel checks (such as guard, positivity, or universe checking), or use equivalent shortcuts.
- Work offline. Use only the supplied input and permitted local libraries. Do not look up, copy, or import an existing proof of any target.

## Deliverable

A completed `Task.v` that compiles with Rocq using the supplied project configuration, with every listed target proved and no open goals.

To verify, run `make` from the project root. All project dependencies are included.

Standard solution: prove the substitution lemma with the statement that x's binding can be anywhere, and define the substituted context where x's binding is dropped and all subsequent bindings' terms substituted. Alternative standard trick: prove weakening first (extending at the end), then use it to move x's binding to the end? Can't move bindings.

content.thinking:
Env is a list; get_impl is lookup (probably with shadowing). There's no env extensionality lemma listed, but we can prove our own: E = keys E ~* values E, so envs are determined by their keys/values. And map functions. Could prove env equality by induction on the list.

Rather than context reordering, maybe easier to define substitution on envs directly and prove lemmas about it.

Let me now decide the overall architecture. I'll aim to prove:

A. Syntactic/open/subst lemmas:
   - open_trm_wrt_trm_rec with var_f x substitution...
   - lc_trm is preserved by open/subst by var_f (standard).
   - subst_trm x argv (open e (var_f x)) = open e argv (when x not free in e).
   Actually note `subst_trm` and opening don't shift indices. Let's define:
     Lemma subst_open_var : forall e x argv, x \notin fv_trm e -> subst_trm argv x (open e (var_f x)) = open e argv. 
   Prove by induction on e.
   Also: for binders, open at level k and substitution commute in suitable ways.
   Also need: if x \notin fv_trm e then subst argv x e = e.
   And: fv/subst interaction.

B. sub-level lemmas:
   1. sub_wf : sub G e1 e2 A -> wf G.
   2. wf_ok : wf G -> ok G.
   3. Maybe wf implies bindings' well-formedness: wf G -> binds x (bind_sub e A) G -> sub G e e A /\ sub G A A star. Prove by induction on G (using env_ind) rather than on wf derivation? Since wf G is inductive and wf_cons has no wf G premise, we can invert: wf empty or wf (G'&x~e:A) with sub G' e e A, sub G' A A star, x#G'. For binds in G'&x~e:A: if binds at x, get e,A; elif binds in G', need to lift typing from G' to G = G'&x~e:A (weakening). So need weakening.
   4. weakening: sub G e1 e2 A -> sub (G & x ~ b) e1 e2 A? Needs wf (G&x~b) for sub_ax/var_refl subcases. We can instead formulate with wf (G&x~b) assumption. But perhaps use a more general "sub_env" relation.

Set Implicit Arguments.

From TLC Require Import LibLN.

Require Import Full_ott Full_Infra.

Require Import Lia List.

Implicit Types x : var.

(* ********************************************************************** *)
(* Syntactic preliminaries                                                *)
(* ********************************************************************** *)

Definition open_var_rec (k:nat) (x:var) (e:trm) : trm :=
  open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k (trm_var_f x) e.

(* [nb m e] : every de Bruijn index in [e] is bound, where the outermost
   [m] levels are considered bound by an enclosing context.  In other
   words, index [n] occurring under [d] binders satisfies [n < m + d]. *)

Inductive nb (m:nat) : trm -> Prop :=
 | nb_var_b : forall n, n < m -> nb m (trm_var_b n)
 | nb_var_f : forall x, nb m (trm_var_f x)
 | nb_star : nb m trm_star
 | nb_top : nb m trm_top
 | nb_app : forall e1 e2, nb m e1 -> nb m e2 -> nb m (trm_app e1 e2)
 | nb_abs : forall e1 A e2, nb m e1 -> nb m A -> nb (S m) e2 ->
      nb m (trm_abs e1 A e2)
 | nb_prod : forall e A B, nb m e -> nb m A -> nb (S m) B ->
      nb m (trm_prod e A B)
 | nb_castup : forall A e, nb m A -> nb m e -> nb m (trm_castup A e)
 | nb_castdn : forall e, nb m e -> nb m (trm_castdn e)
 | nb_anno : forall e A, nb m e -> nb m A -> nb m (trm_anno e A).

Lemma lc_var_b_inv : forall n, ~ lc_trm (trm_var_b n).
Proof. intros n H. inversion H. Qed.

Lemma nb_open_rec : forall m e, nb m e ->
  forall k, m <= k -> forall a, open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k a e = e.
Proof.
  intros m e H. induction H; intros k Hk a; simpl.
  - (* var_b *) apply If_r. lia.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - (* app *) rewrite IHH1; auto. rewrite IHH2; auto.
  - (* abs *) rewrite IHH1; auto. rewrite IHH2; auto.
    rewrite IHH3; auto.
  - (* prod *) rewrite IHH1; auto. rewrite IHH2; auto.
    rewrite IHH3; auto.
  - (* castup *) rewrite IHH1; auto. rewrite IHH2; auto.
  - (* castdn *) rewrite IHH1; auto.
  - (* anno *) rewrite IHH1; auto. rewrite IHH2; auto.
Qed.

Fixpoint open_many_from (k:nat) (xs:list var) (e:trm) : trm :=
  match xs with
  | nil => e
  | x :: xs' => open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k (trm_var_f x)
                    (open_many_from (S k) xs' e)
  end.

Lemma om_var_f : forall k xs x,
  open_many_from k xs (trm_var_f x) = trm_var_f x.
Proof.
  intros k xs. induction xs as [|y ys IH]; intros x; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma om_star : forall k xs, open_many_from k xs trm_star = trm_star.
Proof.
  intros k xs. induction xs as [|y ys IH]; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma om_top : forall k xs, open_many_from k xs trm_top = trm_top.
Proof.
  intros k xs. induction xs as [|y ys IH]; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma om_app : forall k xs e1 e2,
  open_many_from k xs (trm_app e1 e2) =
  trm_app (open_many_from k xs e1) (open_many_from k xs e2).
Proof.
  intros k xs. induction xs as [|y ys IH]; intros e1 e2; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma om_abs : forall k xs e1 A e2,
  open_many_from k xs (trm_abs e1 A e2) =
  trm_abs (open_many_from k xs e1) (open_many_from k xs A)
          (open_many_from (S k) xs e2).
Proof.
  intros k xs. induction xs as [|y ys IH]; intros e1 A e2; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma om_prod : forall k xs e A B,
  open_many_from k xs (trm_prod e A B) =
  trm_prod (open_many_from k xs e) (open_many_from k xs A)
           (open_many_from (S k) xs B).
Proof.
  intros k xs. induction xs as [|y ys IH]; intros e A B; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma om_castup : forall k xs A e,
  open_many_from k xs (trm_castup A e) =
  trm_castup (open_many_from k xs A) (open_many_from k xs e).
Proof.
  intros k xs. induction xs as [|y ys IH]; intros A e; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma om_castdn : forall k xs e,
  open_many_from k xs (trm_castdn e) = trm_castdn (open_many_from k xs e).
Proof.
  intros k xs. induction xs as [|y ys IH]; intros e; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma om_anno : forall k xs e A,
  open_many_from k xs (trm_anno e A) =
  trm_anno (open_many_from k xs e) (open_many_from k xs A).
Proof.
  intros k xs. induction xs as [|y ys IH]; intros e A; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma om_var_b_ge : forall k xs n, k + length xs <= n ->
  open_many_from k xs (trm_var_b n) = trm_var_b n.
Proof.
  intros k xs. induction xs as [|y ys IH]; intros n Hle; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. apply If_r. lia.
    lia.
Qed.

(* [open_many_from] with a list of length [m] does not touch indices that
   are at least [m] levels above the root. *)

Lemma nb_of_lc_open : forall m xs e, length xs = m ->
  lc_trm (open_many_from 0 xs e) -> nb m e.
Proof.
  intros m xs e. revert m xs. induction e; intros m xs Hlen Hlc;
    try (rewrite om_var_f in Hlc); try (rewrite om_star in Hlc);
    try (rewrite om_top in Hlc);
    try (inversion Hlc; subst; fail).
  - (* trm_var_b *)
    (* Hlc : lc (open_many_from 0 xs (trm_var_b n)) *)
    destruct (Nat.lt_ge_cases n m) as [Hlt|Hge].
    + apply nb_var_b; auto.
    + exfalso. revert Hlc.
      assert (Hnil : 0 + length xs <= n) by lia.
      rewrite (om_var_b_ge Hnil). intro Hc. apply lc_var_b_inv in Hc. auto.
  - (* trm_app *)
    rewrite om_app in Hlc. inversion Hlc as [| | | e1' e2' Hc1 Hc2| | | | |].
    apply nb_app; [apply IHe1 with (m:=m) (xs:=xs)|apply IHe2 with (m:=m) (xs:=xs)]; auto.
  - (* trm_abs *)
    rewrite om_abs in Hlc.
    inversion Hlc as [| | | | | LL e1' A' e2' Hc1 Hc2 Hbody| | | |].
    apply nb_abs.
    + apply IHe1 with (m:=m) (xs:=xs); auto.
    + apply IHe2 with (m:=m) (xs:=xs); auto.
    + destruct (var_fresh LL) as [y Hy].
      apply IHe3 with (m:=S m) (xs:=y::xs); auto. simpl. lia.
  - (* trm_prod *)
    rewrite om_prod in Hlc.
    inversion Hlc as [| | | | | | LL e' A' B' Hc1 Hc2 Hc3 Hbody| | |].
    apply nb_prod.
    + apply IHe1 with (m:=m) (xs:=xs); auto.
    + apply IHe2 with (m:=m) (xs:=xs); auto.
    + destruct (var_fresh LL) as [y Hy].
      apply IHe3 with (m:=S m) (xs:=y::xs); auto. simpl. lia.
  - (* trm_castup *)
    rewrite om_castup in Hlc. inversion Hlc as [| | | | | | | A' e' Hc1 Hc2| |].
    apply nb_castup.
    + apply IHe1 with (m:=m) (xs:=xs); auto.

Set Implicit Arguments.

From TLC Require Import LibLN.

Require Import Full_ott Full_Infra.

Require Import Lia List.

Implicit Types x : var.

(* ********************************************************************** *)
(* Syntactic preliminaries                                                *)
(* ********************************************************************** *)

Definition open_var_rec (k:nat) (x:var) (e:trm) : trm :=
  open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k (trm_var_f x) e.

(* [nb m e] : every de Bruijn index in [e] is bound, where the outermost
   [m] levels are considered bound by an enclosing context.  In other
   words, index [n] occurring under [d] binders satisfies [n < m + d]. *)

Inductive nb (m:nat) : trm -> Prop :=
 | nb_var_b : forall n, n < m -> nb m (trm_var_b n)
 | nb_var_f : forall x, nb m (trm_var_f x)
 | nb_star : nb m trm_star
 | nb_top : nb m trm_top
 | nb_app : forall e1 e2, nb m e1 -> nb m e2 -> nb m (trm_app e1 e2)
 | nb_abs : forall e1 A e2, nb m e1 -> nb m A -> nb (S m) e2 ->
      nb m (trm_abs e1 A e2)
 | nb_prod : forall e A B, nb m e -> nb m A -> nb (S m) B ->
      nb m (trm_prod e A B)
 | nb_castup : forall A e, nb m A -> nb m e -> nb m (trm_castup A e)
 | nb_castdn : forall e, nb m e -> nb m (trm_castdn e)
 | nb_anno : forall e A, nb m e -> nb m A -> nb m (trm_anno e A).

Lemma lc_var_b_inv : forall n, ~ lc_trm (trm_var_b n).
Proof. intros n H. inversion H. Qed.

Lemma nb_open_rec : forall m e, nb m e ->
  forall k, m <= k -> forall a, open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k a e = e.
Proof.
  intros m e H. induction H; intros k Hk a; simpl.
  - (* var_b *) apply If_r. lia.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - (* app *) rewrite IHH1; auto. rewrite IHH2; auto.
  - (* abs *) rewrite IHH1; auto. rewrite IHH2; auto.
    rewrite IHH3; auto.
  - (* prod *) rewrite IHH1; auto. rewrite IHH2; auto.
    rewrite IHH3; auto.
  - (* castup *) rewrite IHH1; auto. rewrite IHH2; auto.
  - (* castdn *) rewrite IHH1; auto.
  - (* anno *) rewrite IHH1; auto. rewrite IHH2; auto.
Qed.

Fixpoint open_many_from (k:nat) (xs:list var) (e:trm) : trm :=
  match xs with
  | nil => e
  | x :: xs' => open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k (trm_var_f x)
                    (open_many_from (S k) xs' e)
  end.

Lemma om_var_f : forall k xs x,
  open_many_from k xs (trm_var_f x) = trm_var_f x.
Proof.
  intros k xs. induction xs as [|y ys IH]; intros x; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma om_star : forall k xs, open_many_from k xs trm_star = trm_star.
Proof.
  intros k xs. induction xs as [|y ys IH]; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma om_top : forall k xs, open_many_from k xs trm_top = trm_top.
Proof.
  intros k xs. induction xs as [|y ys IH]; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma om_app : forall k xs e1 e2,
  open_many_from k xs (trm_app e1 e2) =
  trm_app (open_many_from k xs e1) (open_many_from k xs e2).
Proof.
  intros k xs. induction xs as [|y ys IH]; intros e1 e2; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma om_abs : forall k xs e1 A e2,
  open_many_from k xs (trm_abs e1 A e2) =
  trm_abs (open_many_from k xs e1) (open_many_from k xs A)
          (open_many_from (S k) xs e2).
Proof.
  intros k xs. induction xs as [|y ys IH]; intros e1 A e2; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma om_prod : forall k xs e A B,
  open_many_from k xs (trm_prod e A B) =
  trm_prod (open_many_from k xs e) (open_many_from k xs A)
           (open_many_from (S k) xs B).
Proof.
  intros k xs. induction xs as [|y ys IH]; intros e A B; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma om_castup : forall k xs A e,
  open_many_from k xs (trm_castup A e) =
  trm_castup (open_many_from k xs A) (open_many_from k xs e).
Proof.
  intros k xs. induction xs as [|y ys IH]; intros A e; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma om_castdn : forall k xs e,
  open_many_from k xs (trm_castdn e) = trm_castdn (open_many_from k xs e).
Proof.
  intros k xs. induction xs as [|y ys IH]; intros e; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma om_anno : forall k xs e A,
  open_many_from k xs (trm_anno e A) =
  trm_anno (open_many_from k xs e) (open_many_from k xs A).
Proof.
  intros k xs. induction xs as [|y ys IH]; intros e A; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma om_var_b_ge : forall k xs n, k + length xs <= n ->
  open_many_from k xs (trm_var_b n) = trm_var_b n.
Proof.
  intros k xs. induction xs as [|y ys IH]; intros n Hle; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. apply If_r. lia.
    lia.
Qed.

(* [open_many_from] with a list of length [m] does not touch indices that
   are at least [m] levels above the root. *)

Lemma nb_of_lc_open : forall m xs e, length xs = m ->
  lc_trm (open_many_from 0 xs e) -> nb m e.
Proof.
  intros m xs e. revert m xs. induction e; intros m xs Hlen Hlc;
    try (rewrite om_var_f in Hlc); try (rewrite om_star in Hlc);
    try (rewrite om_top in Hlc);
    try (inversion Hlc; subst; fail).
  - (* trm_var_b *)
    (* Hlc : lc (open_many_from 0 xs (trm_var_b n)) *)
    destruct (Nat.lt_ge_cases n m) as [Hlt|Hge].
    + apply nb_var_b; auto.
    + exfalso. revert Hlc.
      assert (Hnil : 0 + length xs <= n) by lia.
      rewrite (om_var_b_ge Hnil). intro Hc. apply lc_var_b_inv in Hc. auto.
  - (* trm_app *)
    rewrite om_app in Hlc. inversion Hlc as [| | | e1' e2' Hc1 Hc2| | | | |].
    apply nb_app; [apply IHe1 with (m:=m) (xs:=xs)|apply IHe2 with (m:=m) (xs:=xs)]; auto.
  - (* trm_abs *)
    rewrite om_abs in Hlc.
    inversion Hlc as [| | | | | LL e1' A' e2' Hc1 Hc2 Hbody| | | |].
    apply nb_abs.
    + apply IHe1 with (m:=m) (xs:=xs); auto.
    + apply IHe2 with (m:=m) (xs:=xs); auto.
    + destruct (var_fresh LL) as [y Hy].
      apply IHe3 with (m:=S m) (xs:=y::xs); auto. simpl. lia.
  - (* trm_prod *)
    rewrite om_prod in Hlc.
    inversion Hlc as [| | | | | | LL e' A' B' Hc1 Hc2 Hc3 Hbody| | |].
    apply nb_prod.
    + apply IHe1 with (m:=m) (xs:=xs); auto.
    + apply IHe2 with (m:=m) (xs:=xs); auto.
    + destruct (var_fresh LL) as [y Hy].
      apply IHe3 with (m:=S m) (xs:=y::xs); auto. simpl. lia.
  - (* trm_castup *)
    rewrite om_castup in Hlc. inversion Hlc as [| | | | | | | A' e' Hc1 Hc2| |].
    apply nb_castup.
    + apply IHe1 with (m:=m) (xs:=xs); auto.
    + apply IHe2 with (m:=m) (xs:=xs); auto.
  - (* trm_castdn *)
    rewrite om_castdn in Hlc. inversion Hlc as [| | | | | | | | e' Hc1|].
    apply nb_castdn. apply IHe with (m:=m) (xs:=xs); auto.
  - (* trm_anno *)
    rewrite om_anno in Hlc. inversion Hlc as [| | | | | | | | | e' A' Hc1 Hc2].
    apply nb_anno.
    + apply IHe1 with (m:=m) (xs:=xs); auto.
    + apply IHe2 with (m:=m) (xs:=xs); auto.
Qed.

Lemma lc_nb : forall e, lc_trm e -> nb 0 e.
Proof.
  intros e H. apply (@nb_of_lc_open 0 nil e); auto.
Qed.

Lemma lc_closed_all : forall e, lc_trm e ->
  forall k x, open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k (trm_var_f x) e = e.
Proof.
  intros e Hlc k x. apply (@nb_open_rec 0 e). apply lc_nb; auto. lia.
Qed.

  subst_trm argv x (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k (trm_var_f z) e) =

Proof.
  intros argv x z Hcl Hxz e. induction e; intros k; simpl.
  - (* var_b *)
    destruct (classic (k = n)) as [Heq|Hneq].
    + subst. rewrite If_l; auto. rewrite If_l; auto.
      rewrite If_r; auto.
    + rewrite If_r; auto. rewrite If_r; auto. simpl.
      rewrite If_r; auto.
  - (* var_f *)
    destruct (classic (x = x0)) as [Heq|Hneq].
    + subst. rewrite If_l; auto. rewrite Hcl. rewrite If_l; auto.
    + rewrite If_r; auto. rewrite If_r; auto. rewrite Hcl.
      rewrite If_r; auto.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - (* app *) rewrite IHe1; auto. rewrite IHe2; auto.
  - (* abs *) rewrite IHe1; auto. rewrite IHe2; auto. rewrite IHe3; auto.
  - (* prod *) rewrite IHe1; auto. rewrite IHe2; auto. rewrite IHe3; auto.
  - (* castup *) rewrite IHe1; auto. rewrite IHe2; auto.
  - (* castdn *) rewrite IHe1; auto.
  - (* anno *) rewrite IHe1; auto. rewrite IHe2; auto.
Qed.

Lemma lc_subst_open_var_comm : forall e argv x z,
  lc_trm argv -> x <> z ->
  forall k,
  subst_trm argv x (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k (trm_var_f z) e) =
  open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k (trm_var_f z) (subst_trm argv x e).
Proof.
  intros. apply subst_open_var_comm; auto.
  intros k'. apply lc_closed_all; auto.
Qed.

(* Opening at level 0 with a variable and substituting that variable *)

Lemma subst_open_compose : forall e argv x,
  subst_trm argv x (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec 0 (trm_var_f x) e) =

    + subst. rewrite If_l; auto. rewrite If_l; auto. simpl.
      destruct (classic (0 = n)) as [Hn|Hn].
      * subst. rewrite If_l; auto.
      * rewrite If_r; auto. rewrite If_r; auto.
    + rewrite If_r; auto. rewrite If_r; auto.
      destruct (classic (0 = n)) as [Hn|Hn].
      * subst. rewrite If_l; auto. rewrite If_l; auto.
      * rewrite If_r; auto. rewrite If_r; auto.
  - rewrite IHe1; auto. rewrite IHe2; auto.
  - rewrite IHe1; auto. rewrite IHe2; auto. rewrite IHe3; auto.
  - rewrite IHe1; auto. rewrite IHe2; auto. rewrite IHe3; auto.
  - rewrite IHe1; auto. rewrite IHe2; auto.
  - rewrite IHe1; auto.
  - rewrite IHe1; auto. rewrite IHe2; auto.
Qed.

  - apply nb_anno; auto.
Qed.

Lemma nb_open_rec : forall m e, nb m e -> forall k a, nb m a -> nb m (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k a e).
Proof.
  intros m e H. induction H; intros k b Hb; simpl.
  - destruct (classic (k = n)) as [Heq|Hneq].
    + subst. auto.

(* Substituting a variable for a free variable commutes with opening at a
   different (variable) level, provided the substituted term is locally
   closed. *)

Lemma subst_open_var_comm : forall argv x z,
  (forall k, open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k (trm_var_f z) argv = argv) ->
  x <> z ->
  forall e k,
  subst_trm argv x (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k (trm_var_f z) e) =
  open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k (trm_var_f z) (subst_trm argv x e).
Proof.
  intros argv x z Hcl Hxz e. induction e; intros k; simpl.
  - (* var_b *)
    destruct (classic (k = n)) as [Heq|Hneq].
    + subst. rewrite If_l; auto. rewrite If_l; auto.
      rewrite If_r; auto.
    + rewrite If_r; auto. rewrite If_r; auto. simpl.
      rewrite If_r; auto.
  - (* var_f *)
    destruct (classic (x = x0)) as [Heq|Hneq].
    + subst. rewrite If_l; auto. rewrite Hcl. rewrite If_l; auto.
    + rewrite If_r; auto. rewrite If_r; auto. rewrite Hcl.
      rewrite If_r; auto.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - (* app *) rewrite IHe1; auto. rewrite IHe2; auto.
  - (* abs *) rewrite IHe1; auto. rewrite IHe2; auto. rewrite IHe3; auto.
  - (* prod *) rewrite IHe1; auto. rewrite IHe2; auto. rewrite IHe3; auto.
  - (* castup *) rewrite IHe1; auto. rewrite IHe2; auto.
  - (* castdn *) rewrite IHe1; auto.
  - (* anno *) rewrite IHe1; auto. rewrite IHe2; auto.
Qed.

  lc_trm argv -> x <> z ->

  open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k (trm_var_f z) (subst_trm argv x e).

Lemma lc_subst_open_var_comm : forall e argv x z,
  lc_trm argv -> x <> z ->
  forall k,
  subst_trm argv x (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k (trm_var_f z) e) =
  open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k (trm_var_f z) (subst_trm argv x e).
Proof.
  intros. apply subst_open_var_comm; auto.
  intros k'. apply lc_closed_all; auto.
Qed.

(* Opening at level 0 with a variable and substituting that variable *)

Lemma subst_open_compose : forall e argv x,
  subst_trm argv x (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec 0 (trm_var_f x) e) =
  open_trm_wrt_trm_rec 0 argv e.
Proof.
  induction e; simpl; auto.
  - destruct (classic (x = x0)) as [Heq|Hneq].
    + subst. rewrite If_l; auto. rewrite If_l; auto. simpl.
      destruct (classic (0 = n)) as [Hn|Hn].
      * subst. rewrite If_l; auto.
      * rewrite If_r; auto. rewrite If_r; auto.
    + rewrite If_r; auto. rewrite If_r; auto.
      destruct (classic (0 = n)) as [Hn|Hn].
      * subst. rewrite If_l; auto. rewrite If_l; auto.
      * rewrite If_r; auto. rewrite If_r; auto.
  - rewrite IHe1; auto. rewrite IHe2; auto.
  - rewrite IHe1; auto. rewrite IHe2; auto. rewrite IHe3; auto.
  - rewrite IHe1; auto. rewrite IHe2; auto. rewrite IHe3; auto.
  - rewrite IHe1; auto. rewrite IHe2; auto.
  - rewrite IHe1; auto.
  - rewrite IHe1; auto. rewrite IHe2; auto.
Qed.

(* Basic facts about [nb]. *)

Lemma nb_subst : forall m e argv x, nb m e -> nb m argv ->
  nb m (subst_trm argv x e).
Proof.
  intros m e argv x H. induction H; intros Harg; simpl.
  - apply nb_var_b; auto.
  - destruct (classic (x = x0)) as [Heq|Hneq].
    + subst. auto.
    + apply nb_var_f.
  - apply nb_star.
  - apply nb_top.
  - apply nb_app; auto.
  - apply nb_abs; auto.
  - apply nb_prod; auto.
  - apply nb_castup; auto.
  - apply nb_castdn; auto.
  - apply nb_anno; auto.
Qed.

Lemma nb_open_rec_lc : forall m e, nb m e -> forall k a, nb m a -> nb m (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k a e).
Proof.
  intros m e H. induction H; intros k b Hb; simpl.
  - destruct (classic (k = n)) as [Heq|Hneq].
    + subst. auto.
    + apply nb_var_b; auto.
  - apply nb_var_f.
  - apply nb_star.
  - apply nb_top.
  - apply nb_app; auto.
  - apply nb_abs; auto.
  - apply nb_prod; auto.
  - apply nb_castup; auto.
  - apply nb_castdn; auto.
  - apply nb_anno; auto.
Qed.

  sub E t t T -> t --> t' -> sub E t' t' T.

  x \notin fv_trm e ->
  forall k,
  subst_trm argv x (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k (trm_var_f x) e) =
  open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k argv e.
Proof.
  induction e as [n | y | | | e1 IHe1 e2 IHe2 | e1 IHe1 A IHA e2 IHe2
                | e IHe A IHA B IHB | A IHA e IHe | e IHe | e IHe A IHA ];
  intros argv x Hfv k; simpl in *.
  - (* var_b *)
    destruct (classic (k = n)) as [Heq|Hneq].
    + subst k. rewrite If_l; auto. rewrite subst_trm_var_f_eq. reflexivity.
    + rewrite If_r; auto.
  - (* var_f *)
    apply notin_singleton_r in Hfv.
    rewrite subst_trm_var_f_neq by auto. reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - (* app *)
    apply notin_union_r in Hfv. destruct Hfv as [H1 H2].
    rewrite (IHe1 argv x H1 k), (IHe2 argv x H2 k). reflexivity.
  - (* abs *)
    apply notin_union_r in Hfv. destruct Hfv as [H12 H2].
    apply notin_union_r in H12. destruct H12 as [H1 HA].
    rewrite (IHe1 argv x H1 k), (IHA argv x HA k), (IHe2 argv x H2 (S k)).
    reflexivity.
  - (* prod *)
    apply notin_union_r in Hfv. destruct Hfv as [H12 HB].
    apply notin_union_r in H12. destruct H12 as [H1 HA].
    rewrite (IHe argv x H1 k), (IHA argv x HA k), (IHB argv x HB (S k)).
    reflexivity.
  - (* castup *)
    apply notin_union_r in Hfv. destruct Hfv as [HA H1].
    rewrite (IHA argv x HA k), (IHe argv x H1 k). reflexivity.
  - (* castdn *)
    rewrite (IHe argv x Hfv k). reflexivity.
  - (* anno *)
    apply notin_union_r in Hfv. destruct Hfv as [H1 HA].
    rewrite (IHe argv x H1 k), (IHA argv x HA k). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_open_compose : forall e argv x,
  x \notin fv_trm e ->
  subst_trm argv x (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec 0 (trm_var_f x) e) =
  open_trm_wrt_trm_rec 0 argv e.
Proof. intros. apply (subst_open_compose_gen H k). Qed.

Lemma subenv_push : forall G G' x b,

Proof.

  - apply binds_push_neq_inv in Hy; auto.

## What I established

I built and verified a substantial syntactic foundation in `Task.v` (all of it proven, no admits):

- A locally-nameless `nb` predicate (`nb m e`: de Bruijn indices are bound relative to `m` outer levels), with
  - `nb_open_rec_ge`, `nb_mono`, `nb_subst`, `nb_open_rec_lc`,
  - `open_many_from` with distribution lemmas (`om_app`, `om_abs`, `om_prod`, …),
  - `lc_nb` and `lc_closed_all` (`lc_trm e → open_rec k x e = e`), which required a careful cofinite-opening argument (the supplied `lc_trm` has a cofinite binder rule, so a naive structural induction is unsound here).
- Commutation of substitution with opening:
  - `subst_open_var_comm` / `lc_subst_open_var_comm`,
  - `subst_open_compose_gen` (`x ∉ fv e → subst a x (open_rec k x e) = open_rec k a e`).

These are the pieces a genuine proof would need for the beta case.

## Where it breaks

The hard obligation is **subject reduction for beta when the function's typing is widened through `sub_sub`**:

```
sub G (abs e A body) (abs e A body) (prod e3 B C)
```

can be derived with a principal type `prod e A B0` and a widening `prod e A B0 <: prod e3 B C`.  `sub_prod` then supplies only a *non-diagonal* family relation

```
forall x ∉ L, sub (G & x ~ e3:B) (B0^x) (C^x) star
```

and one needs it after substituting the argument for `x`, i.e. `sub G (B0^^argv) (C^^argv) star`.

- The **diagonal** substitution lemma is provable (its `sub_var_trans` case collapses to the argument's diagonal typing).
- The **non-diagonal** case fails at `sub_var_trans`: it needs the instance of transitivity
  `argv <: e3 : A` and `e3 <: e2 : A ⇒ argv <: e2 : A`
  for arbitrary middle terms.  General transitivity of `sub` is itself blocked by the `sub_app` case, where composing two function judgements at different product types requires a type-changing/parametric composition lemma (`C1^x` vs `C2^x` under an abstract binder).  Proving that appears to require the paper's semantic/logical-relation ("compatibility") development for this dependent subtyping system, not a direct induction on the derivation.

I attempted the standard ways around this: weakening (`sub_weaken`, blocked by regularity for extended contexts), regularity (needs substitution), left/right projection, and transitive-closure shape lemmas.  Each circularity reduces to the same dependent-family composition/parametricity obligation, which I could not mechanize in the available effort.

`Task.v` contains the proven syntactic lemmas above and the two target statements with `Admitted`. It compiles with `rocq c`, but **it does not satisfy the task rules** (no `Admitted`/`admit` allowed) and the targets are not proved. From TLC Require Import LibLN.
Require Import Full_ott Full_Infra.
Require Import Task.
Implicit Types x : var.

Lemma sub_castup_reduct : forall G d e T, sub G d e T ->
  forall B e0, d = trm_castup B e0 -> exists A, reduct B A.
Proof.
  intros G d e T H. induction H; intros Bt et Ed.
  - discriminate Ed.
  - discriminate Ed.
  - discriminate Ed.
  - exact (IHsub Bt et Ed).
  - discriminate Ed.
  - discriminate Ed.
  - discriminate Ed.
  - discriminate Ed.
  - injection Ed as HB _. subst Bt. eexists. eassumption.
  - discriminate Ed.
  - exact (IHsub1 Bt et Ed).
Qed.

Lemma castup_type_shape_gen : forall G d e T, sub G d e T ->
  forall B e0, d = trm_castup B e0 -> (exists A, reduct B A) ->
  (~ (exists p q r, T = trm_prod p q r)) /\ (~ (exists y, T = trm_var_f y)).
Proof.
  intros G d e T H. induction H; intros Bt et Ed Hred.
  - discriminate Ed.
  - discriminate Ed.
  - discriminate Ed.
  - exact (IHsub Bt et Ed Hred).
  - discriminate Ed.
  - discriminate Ed.
  - discriminate Ed.
  - discriminate Ed.
  - (* castup *) injection Ed as HB _. subst Bt. split.
    + intros [p [q [r Hp]]]. rewrite Hp in Hred.
      destruct Hred as [Ax HAx]. apply reduct_prod_inv in HAx; auto.
    + intros [y Hy]. rewrite Hy in Hred.
      destruct Hred as [Ax HAx]. apply reduct_var_f_inv in HAx; auto.
  - discriminate Ed.
  - (* sub_sub *)
    pose proof (IHsub1 Bt et Ed Hred) as [Hnp Hnv].
    split.
    + intros [p [q [r Hp]]].
      destruct (sub_second_prod H0 T eq_refl p q r eq_refl) as
          [[a [b' [c' Ha]]] | [y Hy]]; subst.
      * apply Hnp. exists a, b', c'. reflexivity.
      * apply Hnv. exists y. reflexivity.
    + intros [y Hy].
      apply sub_second_var in H0. destruct H0 as [z Hz]. subst A0.
      apply Hnv. exists z. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma sub_castup_prod_false : forall G B e p q r,
  sub G (trm_castup B e) (trm_castup B e) (trm_prod p q r) -> False.
Proof.
  intros G B e p q r H.
  pose proof (sub_castup_reduct H B e eq_refl) as [A HA].
  pose proof (castup_type_shape_gen H B e eq_refl (ex_intro _ A HA)) as [Hnp _].
  apply Hnp. exists p, q, r. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma sub_star_prod_false : forall G p q r,
  sub G trm_star trm_star (trm_prod p q r) -> False.
Proof.
  intros G p q r H.
  pose proof (sub_star_type_shape_gen H eq_refl) as Hs.
  destruct Hs as [Heq|Heq]; subst; discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma sub_prod_prod_false : forall G a b c p q r,
  sub G (trm_prod a b c) (trm_prod a b c) (trm_prod p q r) -> False.
Proof.
  intros G a b c p q r H.
  pose proof (sub_prod_type_shape_gen H eq_refl) as Hs.
  destruct Hs as [Heq|Heq]; subst; discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma sub_star_inv : forall G e A,
  sub G trm_star e A -> e = trm_star \/ e = trm_top.
Proof.
  intros G e A H.
  remember trm_star as d eqn:Ed.
  revert Ed. induction H; intros Ed; try discriminate Ed.
  - left. reflexivity.
  - right. reflexivity.
  - subst e1. apply IHsub1. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma sub_abs_shape : forall G e A,
  sub G (trm_abs (trm_var_b 0) (trm_var_b 0) (trm_var_b 0)) e A ->
  True.
Proof. auto. Qed.

Lemma sub_second_var : forall G e1 x A,
  sub G e1 (trm_var_f x) A -> exists y, e1 = trm_var_f y.
Proof.
  intros G e1 x A H.
  remember (trm_var_f x) as d eqn:Ed.
  revert Ed. induction H; intros Ed; try discriminate Ed.
  - injection Ed as Hx. subst x5. exists x. reflexivity.
  - exists x5. reflexivity.
  - subst e2. apply IHsub1. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma sub_second_prod : forall G e1 e2 A,
  sub G e1 e2 A ->
  forall d, e2 = d ->
  forall e A' B', d = trm_prod e A' B' ->
  (exists e' A'' B'', e1 = trm_prod e' A'' B'') \/
  (exists x, e1 = trm_var_f x).
Proof.
  intros G e1 e2 A H.
  induction H; intros d Ed eX AX BX Hp.
  - subst d. discriminate Hp.
  - subst d. discriminate Hp.
  - right. exists x5. reflexivity.
  - subst d. discriminate Hp.
  - subst d. discriminate Hp.
  - subst d. discriminate Hp.
  - subst d. discriminate Hp.
  - subst d. injection Hp as He HA HB. subst.
    left. exists e. exists A. exists B. reflexivity.
  - subst d. discriminate Hp.
  - subst d. discriminate Hp.
  - exact (IHsub1 d Ed eX AX BX Hp).
Qed.

(* Type-shape lemmas: kinds of types a judgement can have, by the head of
   its first component. *)

Lemma sub_star_type_shape_gen : forall G d e T,
  sub G d e T -> d = trm_star -> T = trm_star \/ T = trm_top.
Proof.
  intros G d e T H. induction H; intros Ed.
  - left. reflexivity.
  - discriminate Ed.
  - discriminate Ed.
  - apply IHsub. exact Ed.
  - discriminate Ed.
  - discriminate Ed.
  - discriminate Ed.
  - discriminate Ed.
  - discriminate Ed.
  - discriminate Ed.
  - apply IHsub1 in Ed. destruct Ed as [HA|HA]; subst.
    + apply sub_star_inv in H0. destruct H0 as [HB|HB]; subst; auto.
    + apply sub_top_inv in H0. subst. right. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma sub_star_type_shape : forall G e T,
  sub G trm_star e T -> T = trm_star \/ T = trm_top.
Proof. intros G e T H. exact (sub_star_type_shape_gen H eq_refl). Qed.

Lemma sub_prod_type_shape_gen : forall G d e T,
  sub G d e T -> forall p q r, d = trm_prod p q r ->
  T = trm_star \/ T = trm_top.
Proof.
  intros G d e T H. induction H; intros p q r Ed.
  - discriminate Ed.
  - discriminate Ed.
  - discriminate Ed.
  - exact (IHsub p q r Ed).
  - discriminate Ed.
  - discriminate Ed.
  - discriminate Ed.
  - left. reflexivity.

From TLC Require Import LibLN.
Require Import Full_ott Full_Infra.
Require Import Task.
Implicit Types x : var.

Lemma sub_castup_reduct : forall G d e T, sub G d e T ->
  forall B e0, d = trm_castup B e0 -> exists A, reduct B A.
Proof.
  intros G d e T H. induction H; intros Bt et Ed.
  - discriminate Ed.
  - discriminate Ed.
  - discriminate Ed.
  - exact (IHsub Bt et Ed).
  - discriminate Ed.
  - discriminate Ed.
  - discriminate Ed.
  - discriminate Ed.
  - injection Ed as HB _. subst Bt. eexists. eassumption.
  - discriminate Ed.
  - exact (IHsub1 Bt et Ed).
Qed.

Lemma castup_type_shape_gen : forall G d e T, sub G d e T ->
  forall B e0, d = trm_castup B e0 -> (exists A, reduct B A) ->
  (~ (exists p q r, T = trm_prod p q r)) /\ (~ (exists y, T = trm_var_f y)).
Proof.
  intros G d e T H. induction H; intros Bt et Ed Hred.
  - discriminate Ed.
  - discriminate Ed.
  - discriminate Ed.
  - exact (IHsub Bt et Ed Hred).
  - discriminate Ed.
  - discriminate Ed.
  - discriminate Ed.
  - discriminate Ed.
  - (* castup *) injection Ed as HB _. subst Bt. split.
    + intros [p [q [r Hp]]]. rewrite Hp in Hred.
      destruct Hred as [Ax HAx]. apply reduct_prod_inv in HAx; auto.
    + intros [y Hy]. rewrite Hy in Hred.
      destruct Hred as [Ax HAx]. apply reduct_var_f_inv in HAx; auto.
  - discriminate Ed.
  - (* sub_sub *)
    pose proof (IHsub1 Bt et Ed Hred) as [Hnp Hnv].
    split.
    + intros [p [q [r Hp]]].
      destruct (sub_second_prod H0 Hp eq_refl) as
          [[a [b' [c' Ha]]] | [y Hy]].
      * apply Hnp. exists a, b', c'. exact Ha.
      * apply Hnv. exists y. exact Hy.
    + intros [y Hy].
      rewrite Hy in H0.
      apply sub_second_var in H0. destruct H0 as [z Hz].
      apply Hnv. exists z. exact Hz.
Qed.

Lemma sub_castup_prod_false : forall G B e p q r,
  sub G (trm_castup B e) (trm_castup B e) (trm_prod p q r) -> False.
Proof.
  intros G B e p q r H.
  pose proof (@sub_castup_reduct G (trm_castup B e) (trm_castup B e) (trm_prod p q r) H B e eq_refl) as [A HA].
  pose proof (@castup_type_shape_gen G (trm_castup B e) (trm_castup B e) (trm_prod p q r) H B e eq_refl (ex_intro _ A HA)) as [Hnp _].
  apply Hnp. exists p, q, r. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma sub_star_prod_false : forall G p q r,
  sub G trm_star trm_star (trm_prod p q r) -> False.
Proof.
  intros G p q r H.
  pose proof (sub_star_type_shape_gen H eq_refl) as Hs.
  destruct Hs as [Heq|Heq]; subst; discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma sub_prod_prod_false : forall G a b c p q r,
  sub G (trm_prod a b c) (trm_prod a b c) (trm_prod p q r) -> False.
Proof.
  intros G a b c p q r H.
  pose proof (sub_prod_type_shape_gen H eq_refl) as Hs.
  destruct Hs as [Heq|Heq]; subst; discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma sub_castup_reduct : forall G d e T, sub G d e T ->

Proof.
  intros G d e T H. induction H; intros Bt et Ed.
  - discriminate Ed.
  - discriminate Ed.
  - discriminate Ed.
  - exact (IHsub Bt et Ed).
  - discriminate Ed.
  - discriminate Ed.
  - discriminate Ed.
  - discriminate Ed.
  - injection Ed as HB _. subst Bt. eexists. eassumption.
  - discriminate Ed.
  - exact (IHsub1 Bt et Ed).
Qed.

Lemma castup_type_shape_gen : forall G d e T, sub G d e T ->
  forall B e0, d = trm_castup B e0 -> (exists A, reduct B A) ->
  (~ (exists p q r, T = trm_prod p q r)) /\ (~ (exists y, T = trm_var_f y)).

  - discriminate Ed.
  - discriminate Ed.
  - discriminate Ed.

  - discriminate Ed.
  - discriminate Ed.
  - discriminate Ed.

    + intros [y Hy]. rewrite Hy in Hred.

  - discriminate Ed.
  - (* sub_sub *)
    pose proof (IHsub1 Bt et Ed Hred) as [Hnp Hnv].
    split.

          [[a [b' [c' Ha]]] | [y Hy]].
      * apply Hnp. exists a, b', c'. exact Ha.
      * apply Hnv. exists y. exact Hy.
    + intros [y Hy].
      rewrite Hy in H0.

Lemma om_var_b_ge : forall xs k n, k + length xs <= n ->
  open_many_from k xs (trm_var_b n) = trm_var_b n.
Proof.
  intros xs. induction xs as [|y ys IH]; intros k n Hle; simpl in *.
  - reflexivity.
  - assert (Hle' : S k + length ys <= n) by lia.
    rewrite (IH (S k) n Hle').
    apply If_r. lia.
Qed.

(* [open_many_from] with a list of length [m] does not touch indices that
   are at least [m] levels above the root. *)

Lemma nb_of_lc_open : forall m xs e, length xs = m ->
  lc_trm (open_many_from 0 xs e) -> nb m e.
Proof.
  intros m xs e. revert m xs.
  induction e as [n | x | | | e1 IHe1 e2 IHe2 | e1 IHe1 A IHA e2 IHe2 | e IHe A IHA B IHB | A IHA e IHe | e IHe | e IHe A IHA ];
  intros m xs Hlen Hlc.
  - (* var_b *)
    destruct (classic (n < m)) as [Hlt|Hge].
    + apply nb_var_b; auto.
    + exfalso.
      rewrite (@om_var_b_ge xs 0 n) in Hlc by lia.
      apply lc_var_b_inv in Hlc. auto.
  - (* var_f *) rewrite om_var_f in Hlc. apply nb_var_f.
  - (* star *) rewrite om_star in Hlc. apply nb_star.
  - (* top *) rewrite om_top in Hlc. apply nb_top.
  - (* app *)
    rewrite om_app in Hlc. inversion Hlc; subst.
    apply nb_app.
    + apply (IHe1 (length xs) xs); auto.
    + apply (IHe2 (length xs) xs); auto.
  - (* abs *)
    rewrite om_abs in Hlc.
    inversion Hlc as [| | | | LL e1' A' e2' Hc1 Hc2 Hbody| | | |]; subst.
    apply nb_abs.
    + apply (IHe1 (length xs) xs); auto.
    + apply (IHA (length xs) xs); auto.
    + destruct (var_fresh LL) as [y Hy].
      apply (IHe2 (S (length xs)) (y :: xs)).
      * simpl. lia.
      * change (lc_trm (open_many_from 0 (y :: xs) e2)). apply Hbody; auto.
  - (* prod *)
    rewrite om_prod in Hlc.
    inversion Hlc as [| | | | | LL e' A' B' Hc1 Hc2 Hbody| | |]; subst.
    apply nb_prod.
    + apply (IHe (length xs) xs); auto.
    + apply (IHA (length xs) xs); auto.
    + destruct (var_fresh LL) as [y Hy].
      apply (IHB (S (length xs)) (y :: xs)).
      * simpl. lia.
      * change (lc_trm (open_many_from 0 (y :: xs) B)). apply Hbody; auto.
  - (* castup *)
    rewrite om_castup in Hlc. inversion Hlc; subst.
    apply nb_castup.
    + apply (IHA (length xs) xs); auto.
    + apply (IHe (length xs) xs); auto.
  - (* castdn *)
    rewrite om_castdn in Hlc. inversion Hlc; subst.
    apply nb_castdn. apply (IHe (length xs) xs); auto.
  - (* anno *)
    rewrite om_anno in Hlc. inversion Hlc; subst.
    apply nb_anno.
    + apply (IHe (length xs) xs); auto.
    + apply (IHA (length xs) xs); auto.
Qed.

Lemma lc_nb : forall e, lc_trm e -> nb 0 e.
Proof.
  intros e H. apply (@nb_of_lc_open 0 nil e); auto.
Qed.

Lemma lc_closed_all : forall e, lc_trm e ->
  forall k x, open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k (trm_var_f x) e = e.
Proof.
  intros e Hlc k x. apply (@nb_open_rec_ge 0 e). apply lc_nb; auto. lia.
Qed.

(* Substituting a variable for a free variable commutes with opening at a
   different (variable) level, provided the substituted term is locally
   closed. *)

Lemma subst_trm_var_f_eq : forall a x,
  subst_trm a x (trm_var_f x) = a.
Proof. intros. simpl. rewrite If_l; auto. Qed.

Lemma subst_trm_var_f_neq : forall a x y, y <> x ->
  subst_trm a x (trm_var_f y) = trm_var_f y.
Proof. intros. simpl. rewrite If_r; auto. Qed.

Lemma subst_trm_var_b : forall a x n,
  subst_trm a x (trm_var_b n) = trm_var_b n.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma subst_open_var_comm : forall argv x z,
  (forall k, open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k (trm_var_f z) argv = argv) ->
  x <> z ->
  forall e k,
  subst_trm argv x (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k (trm_var_f z) e) =
  open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k (trm_var_f z) (subst_trm argv x e).
Proof.
  intros argv x z Hcl Hxz e.
  induction e as [n | y | | | e1 IHe1 e2 IHe2 | e1 IHe1 A IHA e2 IHe2
                | e IHe A IHA B IHB | A IHA e IHe | e IHe | e IHe A IHA ];
  intros k; simpl.
  - (* var_b *)
    destruct (classic (k = n)) as [Heq|Hneq].
    + subst k. rewrite If_l; auto. simpl.
      apply subst_trm_var_f_neq. auto.
    + rewrite If_r; auto.
  - (* var_f *)
    destruct (classic (y = x)) as [->|Hyx].
    + rewrite If_l; auto.
    + rewrite If_r; auto.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - (* app *) rewrite IHe1; auto. rewrite IHe2; auto.
  - (* abs *) rewrite IHe1; auto. rewrite IHA; auto. rewrite IHe2; auto.
  - (* prod *) rewrite IHe; auto. rewrite IHA; auto. rewrite IHB; auto.
  - (* castup *) rewrite IHA; auto. rewrite IHe; auto.
  - (* castdn *) rewrite IHe; auto.
  - (* anno *) rewrite IHe; auto. rewrite IHA; auto.
Qed.

Lemma lc_subst_open_var_comm : forall e argv x z,
  lc_trm argv -> x <> z ->
  forall k,
  subst_trm argv x (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k (trm_var_f z) e) =
  open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k (trm_var_f z) (subst_trm argv x e).
Proof.
  intros. apply subst_open_var_comm; auto.
  intros k'. apply lc_closed_all; auto.
Qed.

(* Opening with a variable and then substituting that variable *)

Lemma subst_open_compose_gen : forall e argv x,
  x \notin fv_trm e ->
  forall k,
  subst_trm argv x (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k (trm_var_f x) e) =
  open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k argv e.
Proof.
  induction e as [n | y | | | e1 IHe1 e2 IHe2 | e1 IHe1 A IHA e2 IHe2
                | e IHe A IHA B IHB | A IHA e IHe | e IHe | e IHe A IHA ];
  intros argv x Hfv k; simpl in *.
  - (* var_b *)
    destruct (classic (k = n)) as [Heq|Hneq].
    + subst k. rewrite If_l; auto. rewrite subst_trm_var_f_eq.
      rewrite If_l; auto.
    + rewrite If_r; auto. rewrite If_r; auto.
  - (* var_f *)
    apply notin_singleton_r in Hfv.
    rewrite If_r; [reflexivity|]. intro H; apply Hfv; symmetry; auto.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - (* app *)
    apply notin_union_r in Hfv. destruct Hfv as [H1 H2].
    rewrite (IHe1 argv x H1 k), (IHe2 argv x H2 k). reflexivity.
  - (* abs *)
    apply notin_union_r in Hfv. destruct Hfv as [H1 Hrest].
    apply notin_union_r in Hrest. destruct Hrest as [HA H2].
    rewrite (IHe1 argv x H1 k), (IHA argv x HA k), (IHe2 argv x H2 (S k)).
    reflexivity.
  - (* prod *)
    apply notin_union_r in Hfv. destruct Hfv as [H1 Hrest].
    apply notin_union_r in Hrest. destruct Hrest as [HA HB].
    rewrite (IHe argv x H1 k), (IHA argv x HA k), (IHB argv x HB (S k)).
    reflexivity.
  - (* castup *)
    apply notin_union_r in Hfv. destruct Hfv as [HA H1].
    rewrite (IHA argv x HA k), (IHe argv x H1 k). reflexivity.
  - (* castdn *)
    rewrite (IHe argv x Hfv k). reflexivity.
  - (* anno *)
    apply notin_union_r in Hfv. destruct Hfv as [H1 HA].
    rewrite (IHe argv x H1 k), (IHA argv x HA k). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_open_compose : forall e argv x,
  x \notin fv_trm e ->
  subst_trm argv x (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec 0 (trm_var_f x) e) =
  open_trm_wrt_trm_rec 0 argv e.
Proof. intros. exact (@subst_open_compose_gen e argv x H 0). Qed.

(* Basic facts about [nb]. *)

Lemma nb_mono : forall m e, nb m e -> nb (S m) e.
Proof.
  intros m e H. induction H.
  - apply nb_var_b; lia.
  - apply nb_var_f.
  - apply nb_star.
  - apply nb_top.
  - apply nb_app; auto.
  - apply nb_abs; auto.
  - apply nb_prod; auto.
  - apply nb_castup; auto.
  - apply nb_castdn; auto.
  - apply nb_anno; auto.
Qed.

Lemma nb_subst : forall m e argv x, nb m e -> nb m argv ->
  nb m (subst_trm argv x e).
Proof.
  intros m e argv x H. induction H; intros Harg; simpl.
  - apply nb_var_b; auto.
  - destruct (classic (x0 = x)) as [Heq|Hneq].
    + subst x0. rewrite If_l; auto.
    + rewrite If_r; auto. apply nb_var_f.
  - apply nb_star.
  - apply nb_top.
  - apply nb_app; auto.
  - apply nb_abs; auto. apply IHnb3. apply nb_mono; auto.
  - apply nb_prod; auto. apply IHnb3. apply nb_mono; auto.
  - apply nb_castup; auto.
  - apply nb_castdn; auto.
  - apply nb_anno; auto.
Qed.

From TLC Require Import LibLN.
Require Import Full_ott Full_Infra Task.
Implicit Types x : var.

Lemma sub_comp_try : forall G e1 e2 e3 A,
  sub G e1 e2 A -> sub G e2 e3 A -> sub G e1 e3 A.
Proof.
  intros G e1 e2 e3 A H1 H2.
  revert e3 H2.
  induction H1; intros e3 H2.
  - (* ax *) exact H2.
  - (* var_refl *) exact H2.
  - (* var_trans *)
    eapply sub_var_trans; [ eassumption | ].
    eapply IHprem. exact H2.
  - (* top *)
    apply sub_top_inv in H2. subst e3.
    eapply sub_top. exact Hprem.
  - (* top_refl *) exact H2.
  - (* abs *)
    (* H2 : sub G (abs e1 A0 e2') e3 (prod e1 A0 B) *)
    Show.
Abort.

  open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k (trm_var_f x) e.

(* [nb m e] : every de Bruijn index in [e] is bound, where the outermost

Inductive nb (m:nat) : trm -> Prop :=
 | nb_var_b : forall n, n < m -> nb m (trm_var_b n)
 | nb_var_f : forall x, nb m (trm_var_f x)
 | nb_star : nb m trm_star
 | nb_top : nb m trm_top
 | nb_app : forall e1 e2, nb m e1 -> nb m e2 -> nb m (trm_app e1 e2)
 | nb_abs : forall e1 A e2, nb m e1 -> nb m A -> nb (S m) e2 ->

      nb m (trm_prod e A B)

 | nb_castdn : forall e, nb m e -> nb m (trm_castdn e)

Lemma lc_var_b_inv : forall n, ~ lc_trm (trm_var_b n).
Proof. intros n H. inversion H. Qed.

Lemma reduct_subst : forall argv x, lc_trm argv ->
  forall t u, reduct t u ->
  reduct (subst_trm argv x t) (subst_trm argv x u).
Proof.
  intros argv x Hlc t u Hred. induction Hred; simpl.
  - (* beta *)
    change (reduct
      (trm_app (trm_abs (subst_trm argv x e3) (subst_trm argv x A) (subst_trm argv x e1))
               (subst_trm argv x e2))
      (subst_trm argv x (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec 0 e2 e1))).
    rewrite subst_open_rec_comm_gen; auto.
    apply reduct_beta.
    + apply lc_subst; auto.
    + apply lc_subst; auto.
    + inversion H1 as [| | | | L0 d1 Ad b Hd1 HdA Hbody| | | |]; subst.
      apply (@lc_trm_abs (L0 \u \{x})).
      * apply lc_subst; auto.
      * apply lc_subst; auto.
      * intros z Hz.
        apply notin_union_r1 in Hz as Hz0.
        apply notin_union_r2 in Hz as Hzx.
        apply notin_singleton_r in Hzx.
        pose proof (Hbody z Hz0) as Hzb.
        pose proof (@lc_subst (e1 ^ z) argv x Hzb Hlc) as Hzs.
        change (lc_trm (subst_trm argv x
                  (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec 0 (trm_var_f z) e1))) in Hzs.
        rewrite (@lc_subst_open_var_comm e1 argv x z
                   Hlc (not_eq_sym Hzx) 0) in Hzs.
        exact Hzs.
    + apply lc_subst; auto.
  - (* app congruence *)
    apply reduct_app.
    + apply lc_subst; auto.
    + auto.
  - (* castdn congruence *) apply reduct_castdn; auto.
  - (* castelim *)
    apply reduct_castelim.
    + apply lc_subst; auto.
    + apply lc_subst; auto.
Qed.

  intros G A B H.
  remember trm_star as d eqn:Ed.
  revert Ed. induction H as
    [ G0 Hwf
    | G0 x5 A0 e0 Hwf Hb
    | G0 x5 e2 A0 e1 Hb Hprem IHprem
    | G0 e0 A0 Hprem IHprem
    | G0 A0 Hprem IHprem
    | L G0 e1 A0 e2 e2' B0 h1 IH1 h2 IH2 hbody IHbody hbs IHbstar
    | G0 e1 A0 e2 C e3 B0 h1 IH1 h2 IH2
    | L G0 e A0 B0 e' A' B' h1 IH1 h2 IH2 h3 IH3 h4 IH4 h5 IH5 h6 IH6 h7 IH7
    | G0 B0 e1 e2 A0 h1 IH1 h2 IH2 hr

    eapply sub_app.

Lemma sub_prod_idx_example : forall x,
  sub (empty & x ~ bind_sub trm_star trm_star)

      (trm_prod (trm_var_f x) trm_star trm_star)
      trm_star.

  intros x.

  assert (Hwf : wf G).

    - apply sub_ax. apply wf_nil.
    - apply sub_ax. apply wf_nil.

  assert (Hax : sub G trm_star trm_star trm_star).

  - (* h5 *) intros y Hy. apply sub_ax.
    apply wf_cons.
    + exact Hx.

From TLC Require Import LibLN.

Inductive trm : Set :=
 | trm_var_b (_:nat)
 | trm_var_f (x5:var)
 | trm_star : trm
 | trm_top : trm
 | trm_app (e1:trm) (e2:trm)
 | trm_abs (e1:trm) (A:trm) (e2:trm)
 | trm_prod (e:trm) (A:trm) (B:trm)
 | trm_castup (A:trm) (e:trm)
 | trm_castdn (e:trm)
 | trm_anno (e:trm) (A:trm)  .

Inductive binding : Set :=
 | bind_sub (e:trm) (A:trm)  .

Definition env := LibEnv.env binding.

Fixpoint open_trm_wrt_trm_rec (k:nat) (e_5:trm) (e__6:trm) {struct e__6}: trm :=
  match e__6 with
  | (trm_var_b nat) => If (k = nat) then e_5 else (trm_var_b nat)
  | (trm_var_f x5) => trm_var_f x5
  | trm_star => trm_star
  | trm_top => trm_top
  | (trm_app e1 e2) => trm_app (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k e_5 e1) (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k e_5 e2)
  | (trm_abs e1 A e2) => trm_abs (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k e_5 e1) (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k e_5 A) (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec (S k) e_5 e2)
  | (trm_prod e A B) => trm_prod (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k e_5 e) (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k e_5 A) (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec (S k) e_5 B)
  | (trm_castup A e) => trm_castup (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k e_5 A) (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k e_5 e)
  | (trm_castdn e) => trm_castdn (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k e_5 e)
  | (trm_anno e A) => trm_anno (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k e_5 e) (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k e_5 A)
end.

Definition open_binding_wrt_trm_rec (k:nat) (e5:trm) (b5:binding) : binding :=
  match b5 with
  | (bind_sub e A) => bind_sub (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k e5 e) (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k e5 A)
end.

Definition open_binding_wrt_trm e5 b5 := open_binding_wrt_trm_rec 0 b5 e5.

Definition open_trm_wrt_trm e_5 e__6 := open_trm_wrt_trm_rec 0 e__6 e_5.

Inductive lc_trm : trm -> Prop :=
 | lc_trm_var_f : forall (x5:var),
     (lc_trm (trm_var_f x5))
 | lc_trm_star :
     (lc_trm trm_star)
 | lc_trm_top :
     (lc_trm trm_top)
 | lc_trm_app : forall (e1 e2:trm),
     (lc_trm e1) ->
     (lc_trm e2) ->
     (lc_trm (trm_app e1 e2))
 | lc_trm_abs : forall (L:vars) (e1 A e2:trm),
     (lc_trm e1) ->
     (lc_trm A) ->
      ( forall x5 , x5 \notin  L  -> lc_trm  ( open_trm_wrt_trm e2 (trm_var_f x5) )  )  ->
     (lc_trm (trm_abs e1 A e2))
 | lc_trm_prod : forall (L:vars) (e A B:trm),
     (lc_trm e) ->
     (lc_trm A) ->
      ( forall x5 , x5 \notin  L  -> lc_trm  ( open_trm_wrt_trm B (trm_var_f x5) )  )  ->
     (lc_trm (trm_prod e A B))
 | lc_trm_castup : forall (A e:trm),
     (lc_trm A) ->
     (lc_trm e) ->
     (lc_trm (trm_castup A e))
 | lc_trm_castdn : forall (e:trm),
     (lc_trm e) ->
     (lc_trm (trm_castdn e))
 | lc_trm_anno : forall (e A:trm),
     (lc_trm e) ->
     (lc_trm A) ->
     (lc_trm (trm_anno e A)).

Inductive lc_binding : binding -> Prop :=
 | lc_bind_sub : forall (e A:trm),
     (lc_trm e) ->
     (lc_trm A) ->
     (lc_binding (bind_sub e A)).

Fixpoint fv_trm (e_5:trm) : vars :=
  match e_5 with
  | (trm_var_b nat) => \{}
  | (trm_var_f x5) => \{x5}
  | trm_star => \{}
  | trm_top => \{}
  | (trm_app e1 e2) => (fv_trm e1) \u (fv_trm e2)
  | (trm_abs e1 A e2) => (fv_trm e1) \u (fv_trm A) \u (fv_trm e2)
  | (trm_prod e A B) => (fv_trm e) \u (fv_trm A) \u (fv_trm B)
  | (trm_castup A e) => (fv_trm A) \u (fv_trm e)
  | (trm_castdn e) => (fv_trm e)
  | (trm_anno e A) => (fv_trm e) \u (fv_trm A)
end.

Definition fv_binding (b5:binding) : vars :=
  match b5 with
  | (bind_sub e A) => (fv_trm e) \u (fv_trm A)
end.

Fixpoint subst_trm (e_5:trm) (y5:var) (e__6:trm) {struct e__6} : trm :=
  match e__6 with
  | (trm_var_b nat) => trm_var_b nat
  | (trm_var_f x5) => (If x5 = y5 then e_5 else (trm_var_f x5))
  | trm_star => trm_star

Set Implicit Arguments.

From TLC Require Import LibLN.

Require Import Full_ott Full_Infra.

Require Import Lia List.

Implicit Types x : var.

(* ********************************************************************** *)
(* Syntactic preliminaries                                                *)
(* ********************************************************************** *)

Definition open_var_rec (k:nat) (x:var) (e:trm) : trm :=
  open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k (trm_var_f x) e.

(* [nb m e] : every de Bruijn index in [e] is bound, where the outermost
   [m] levels are considered bound by an enclosing context.  In other
   words, index [n] occurring under [d] binders satisfies [n < m + d]. *)

Inductive nb (m:nat) : trm -> Prop :=
 | nb_var_b : forall n, n < m -> nb m (trm_var_b n)
 | nb_var_f : forall x, nb m (trm_var_f x)
 | nb_star : nb m trm_star
 | nb_top : nb m trm_top
 | nb_app : forall e1 e2, nb m e1 -> nb m e2 -> nb m (trm_app e1 e2)
 | nb_abs : forall e1 A e2, nb m e1 -> nb m A -> nb (S m) e2 ->
      nb m (trm_abs e1 A e2)
 | nb_prod : forall e A B, nb m e -> nb m A -> nb (S m) B ->
      nb m (trm_prod e A B)

(* Full component extraction for product subtyping.  Since [sub_sub]
   preserves both terms, any derivation of a product-to-product judgment
   bottoms out in a single [sub_prod] between the very same endpoint
   products, so all the [sub_prod] premises are available for the
   endpoints.  This is used to recover the domain term/type relations and
   the codomain family relation of a product widening.                     *)

Lemma sub_prod_full_gen : forall G d e T,
  sub G d e T ->
  forall p q r p' q' r',
    d = trm_prod p q r -> e = trm_prod p' q' r' ->
    (sub G q' q trm_star) /\
    (sub G p' p q) /\
    (sub G q q trm_star) /\
    (exists L, forall x, x \notin L ->
        sub (G & x ~ bind_sub p q) (r ^ x) (r ^ x) trm_star) /\
    (exists L, forall x, x \notin L ->
        sub (G & x ~ bind_sub p' q') (r ^ x) (r' ^ x) trm_star) /\
    (sub G p p q) /\
    (sub G p' p' q').
Proof.
  intros G d e T H.
  induction H as
    [ G0 Hwf
    | G0 x5 A0 e0 Hwf Hb
    | G0 x5 e2 A0 e1 Hb Hprem IHprem
    | G0 e0 A0 Hprem IHprem
    | G0 A0 Hprem IHprem
    | L G0 e1 A0 e2 e2' B h1 IH1 h2 IH2 hbody IHbody hbs IHbstar
    | G0 e1 A0 e2 C e3 B h1 IH1 h2 IH2
    | L G0 e A0 B e' A' B' h1 IH1 h2 IH2 h3 IH3 h4 IH4 h5 IH5 h6 IH6 h7 IH7
    | G0 B e1 e2 A0 h1 IH1 h2 IH2 hr
    | G0 e1 e2 B A0 h1 IH1 h2 IH2 hr
    | G0 e1 e2 B A0 h1 IH1 h2 IH2 ];
  intros p q r p' q' r' Ed Ee; try discriminate Ed.
  - (* sub_top: the right component is [top] *)
    discriminate Ee.
  - (* sub_prod *)
    injection Ed as He HA HB. injection Ee as He' HA' HB'. subst.
    split. exact h1.
    split. exact h2.
    split. exact h3.
    split. exists L. exact h4.
    split. exists L. exact h5.
    split. exact h6.
    exact h7.
  - (* sub_sub: terms are preserved *)
    exact (IH1 p q r p' q' r' Ed Ee).
Qed.

        sub (G & x ~ bind_sub p q) (r ^ x) (r ^ x) trm_star) /\
    (exists L, forall x, x \notin L ->
        sub (G & x ~ bind_sub p' q') (r ^ x) (r' ^ x) trm_star) /\
    (sub G p p q) /\
    (sub G p' p' q').
Proof.
  intros G d e T H.
  induction H as
    [ G0 Hwf
    | G0 x5 A0 e0 Hwf Hb
    | G0 x5 e2 A0 e1 Hb Hprem IHprem
    | G0 e0 A0 Hprem IHprem
    | G0 A0 Hprem IHprem
    | L G0 e1 A0 e2 e2' B h1 IH1 h2 IH2 hbody IHbody hbs IHbstar
    | G0 e1 A0 e2 C e3 B h1 IH1 h2 IH2
    | L G0 e A0 B e' A' B' h1 IH1 h2 IH2 h3 IH3 h4 IH4 h5 IH5 h6 IH6 h7 IH7
    | G0 B e1 e2 A0 h1 IH1 h2 IH2 hr
    | G0 e1 e2 B A0 h1 IH1 h2 IH2 hr
    | G0 e1 e2 B A0 h1 IH1 h2 IH2 ];
  intros p q r p' q' r' Ed Ee; try discriminate Ed.
  - (* sub_top: the right component is [top] *)
    discriminate Ee.
  - (* sub_prod *)
    injection Ed as He HA HB. injection Ee as He' HA' HB'. subst.
    split. exact h1.
    split. exact h2.
    split. exact h3.
    split. exists L. exact h4.
    split. exists L. exact h5.
    split. exact h6.
    exact h7.
  - (* sub_sub: terms are preserved *)
    exact (IH1 p q r p' q' r' Ed Ee).
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.

From TLC Require Import LibLN.

Require Import Full_ott Full_Infra.

Implicit Types x : var.

(* ********************************************************************** *)
(* Syntactic preliminaries                                                *)
